lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 4-5 visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots, each column containing 3-6 nodes, spanning the visible mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin junction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the longitudinal rows of spots, forming a distinct rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-body.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible running longitudinally along the upper flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance gradient on the upper edge and distinct shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small, low-contrast oval objects (commensal fish) concentrated around the posterior edge of the pectoral fin and trailing along the ventral-lateral midline.
